description: Change of use of industrial premises to a mixed use of industrial and a waste transfer station for bulking up and transfer of sanitary and clinical waste.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Planning statement], [GPP/CH/I/20/01], [GPP/CH/I/20/02], [GPP/CH/I/20/03], [GPP/CH/I/20/04], Received: 06/05/2020, [Operational management plan], Received: 05/06/2020, [GPP/CH/I/20/02-1], Received: 17/06/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - When the development hereby permitted is first brought into use, the submitted Operational Management Plan must be immediately implemented and adhered to throughout the lifetime of the development
Condition : 4 - The 'roll-on-roll-off' storage container must be permanently locked except when loading.
Condition : 5 - The waste stored and transported on the site shall be restricted to the substances specified within the submitted planning statement.
Condition : 6 - The applicant must ensure arrangements are in place to ensure that any leakages from the skip are intercepted so that no effluent is discharged into the surface water drainage system.
